== nativeTv Home
toggle  nativeTv Home = On [on] -> Turn off (confirms) <home>
toggle  Hide LG’s Home while the TV starts = Off [off] -> Turn on (confirms) <home>
toggle  Power-on screen = nativeTv Home [on] -> Turn off <power>
== Appearance
toggle  Show app names = On [on] -> Turn off <home>
toggle  Show inputs = On [on] -> Turn off <hdmi>
toggle  Show Live = Off [off] -> Turn on <home>
toggle  Show the LG Home tile = On [on] -> Turn off <apps>
toggle  Picture details = Off [off] -> Turn on <home>
action  Clock format = 12-hour -> Change <clock>
link    Profile -> Open <access>
== Apps
action  Order = Your order -> Change <home>
toggle  Streamline = Shown [on] -> Turn off <home>
toggle  Tunes = Shown [on] -> Turn off <home>
toggle  Arcade = Shown [on] -> Turn off <home>
toggle  Lens = Shown [on] -> Turn off <home>
== Inputs
action  Order = Your order -> Change <home>
toggle  Game Console = Shown [on] -> Turn off <game>
link    Add channels = Browse -> Open <home>
== Wallpaper
info    Wallpaper = Black <home>
== More
action  Reset the layout -> Reset (confirms) <refresh>
